source.title: Solution to two open problems on perturbations of the product copula

trace.notes: Normalized one URL source, https://zbmath.org/7117946, as a zbMATH resolver record. The source URL is not itself a technical full-text artifact.

The local resolver row and zbMATH API identified the exact work as 'Solution to two open problems on perturbations of the product copula' with zbMATH id 7117946, identifier 1426.62152, DOI 10.1016/j.fss.2018.06.013, and source Fuzzy Sets and Systems 354, 116-122 (2019).

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with metadata_only candidates. Unpaywall reported is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, no repository copy, and no OA locations. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, any_repository_has_fulltext=false, no best_oa_location, and no primary pdf_url. Crossref confirmed the DOI and publisher landing/resource URL but exposed only publisher text-mining links, not a readable primary source artifact in this run.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact-work searches for the exact title plus PDF, the exact DOI plus PDF, and PII/title-author variants. Inspected candidates were rejected because they were a ScienceDirect abstract/section-snippet page, DBLP metadata, BrujulaUAL metadata, a UCM publication list, or unrelated/citing pages rather than a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.
Mapping was skipped because no readable PDF or full HTML primary source for the exact work was recovered.

No candidate questions were extracted because source adequacy failed: metadata records, abstracts, citation pages, search snippets, and section snippets are not acceptable technical evidence under the workflow contract.
Saved failure JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-7117946.json and outputs/latest.json.
